latest_release.body: ## Install / Update Install the `dsh-context` plugin on [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) with released [NPM package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-context): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context@latest ``` Update the `dsh-context` plugin: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-context@latest ``` ## What's New ### Features - **Injection rows show the owning agent** — Events cards and Context Browser inject-row previews resolve the agent host-side, from the 0.2.2-rc.2+ message text, the parent subagent catalog, team membership, and session-reference labels, and show it as the last label segment. The resolved name rides the fold on surface nodes (`SurfaceNode.agent`, additive-optional), so every browser row gets it regardless of the event window; unresolved names are omitted instead of printing session ids, and the settled summary moves into the row tooltip. - **Category rows tinted with their color** — each Context Browser category row carries a faint gradient wash in its category color, across idle, selected and expanded states, so the rows read with the same color system as the composition bar and DNA feed. - **Filter the command list from the summary cells** — the four summary KPI cells of the command panel become buttons: clicking applies the matching lens (all / failed / background / …) to the right-hand list, clearing the filter box, releasing the program pick and resetting the sort, like the attention rows do. The cells gain the stats-card hover, a pointer cursor and a focus-visible ring. - **Each locale's README ships as the plugin detail document** — every locale dictionary carries `meta.detail` pointing at its README (`README.md` for zh, `README_.md` otherwise), and the localized READMEs ship in the package, so the plugin detail view shows the document in the user's language. ### Fixes - **Keep the scroll position when a windowed category expands** — the windowed list's scroll compensation no longer treats the first measurement of the rows element as a list shift, so expanding a category above the windowing threshold no longer jumps the view past its header and toolbar. ### Changes - Remove the "All" range preset from Context Insights — the range switch and the default-range preference no longer offer All, a missing or unknown range resolves to the 30d preset, and the session-group reset chip gets its own label. - Development: `pnpm run web` saves the tokenized startup URL to `.tmp/dsh-web-url.txt` (removed when the server stops or restarts). - Docs: subagent prompt word limit in AGENTS.md updated from "Under 400 words" to "Under 1000 words". ## Commits -
